notes: Upstream Kerberos v1.5.0-rc.1 5-axis variable fonts (CALE, GRAD, YTLC, opsz, wght). During `cargo run`, the build fetches and SHA-256-verifies these release assets into `target/font-cache/` and automatically generates two-stage WOFF2 subsets covering the site's exact rendered Unicode characters: lightweight [opsz]-only boot cuts for instant zero-CLS first paint, plus progressive [CALE,opsz,wght] variable cuts loaded after first paint.
